summary_1line: Stories illustrate royal generosity and duty: Yayati’s charity, Vrishadarbha’s restitution after striking a Brahmana, and the beginning of the test of King Sivi’s protection of a pigeon.

image_candidates.scene_text: A terrified pigeon falls onto King Sivi’s lap while a hawk swoops above in the royal court before astonished priests.
King Vrishadarbha strikes a Brahmana with a whip in the court, then remorsefully promises him all tribute collected before morning.
A humble Brahmana receives a thousand cows from King Yayati seated on his throne amid gathered citizens.
